app.name: Nostek Panel
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in to manage your server.
login2fa.title: Two-factor check
login2fa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one recovery code.
setup.title: Create the first admin
setup.lead: This one-time link creates the administrator. Next you will set up two-factor sign-in.
enrol.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enrol.step1: 1. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app.
enrol.manual: Or type this key by hand:
enrol.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.lead: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them in your password manager now; they are not shown again.
dash.codeslow: Fewer than 3 recovery codes left. Create new ones on your Profile page.
settings.tz.help: Every time in the panel is shown in this zone.
settings.codes.new: Create new codes (old ones stop working)
reveal.title: New admin password
reveal.lead: This link shows the new password once. Store it in your password manager before you leave this page.
linkgone.title: Link not valid
linkgone.lead: This link was already used or has expired. Ask for a new one on the server.
notfound.title: Not found
err.pwshort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
err.code: The code is not valid. Try the newest code.
err.toomany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
settings.theme.help: Light, dark, or follow your device. Saved on your account.
dash.sites.go: Add and manage websites: WordPress, Laravel, PHP and static sites.
sites.noagent: The site agent is not reachable, so websites cannot be shown or changed. Status is unknown, not OK. Install or start it with the SITE-01 package.
sites.trash.help: Deleted websites stay here with their files and database for 7 days, then they are removed for good.
sites.new.help: The domain may still point to another host. Then the website starts on its preview address, and the domain is connected after the move.
sites.php.eol: end of life, no security fixes
sites.aliases.help: Separate with spaces or commas. They redirect to the main address.
sites.title: Website title
sites.approve.lead: This creates the website %s. Nothing changes until you approve.
sites.creates.apache: Containers: Apache with PHP, MariaDB database. Own private network; only the web server is reachable through the edge.
sites.creates.nginx: Containers: Nginx, PHP-FPM, MariaDB database. Own private network; only Nginx is reachable through the edge.
sites.resources.apache: Up to 1 GB memory (512 MB web, 512 MB database); disk grows with the website.
sites.resources.nginx: Up to 1.1 GB memory (128 MB Nginx, 512 MB PHP, 512 MB database); disk grows with the website.
sites.undo.text: Delete moves the website to the trash for 7 days; it can be restored from there.
sites.job.wait: Usually 1 to 3 minutes. Progress updates by itself.
sites.job.failhelp: Nothing else was changed. You can delete the website from its page and try again.
sites.job.pwhelp: The password is shown one time only. Save it in your password manager right away.
sites.job.pwonce: Save this password now. It is not stored in the panel and cannot be shown again.
sites.job.pwgone: The admin password was already shown (or has expired). Use "Lost your password" in WordPress to set a new one.
sites.delete.help: Stops the website and moves it to the trash for 7 days. Type %s to confirm.
sites.delete.mismatch: The domain you typed does not match. Nothing was deleted.
sites.done.restore_failed: The website could not be restored. See the activity log.
profile.saved.pw: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
profile.look.help: Theme and highlight colour. Saved on your account.
profile.pw.help: At least 12 characters. After the change, every other device is signed out.
err.pwsame: The new password must differ from the current one.
settings.moved.help: Theme, highlight colour, password and recovery codes are on your Profile page.
sites.step.now.pull images: Downloading images (the first site can take 1-2 minutes)…
stack.title: Stack
stack.help: The containers of this website. CPU and memory update by themselves every few seconds.
stack.err: The containers cannot be read right now:
files.title: File Manager
files.help: Files of this WordPress website (the folder served at its address). The database and the website's secrets are not in here and cannot be reached from here.
files.name: Name
files.delete.ask: Move %s to the trash? It can be restored for 7 days.
files.truncated: This folder has more than 5000 entries; only the first 5000 are shown.
files.upload.help: Up to %s per file. Uploading a .zip? Extract it here afterwards from its ⋯ menu.
files.upload.overwrite: Replace files with the same name
files.trash.help: Deleted files and folders stay here for 7 days, then they are removed for good.
files.trash.empty: Nothing deleted in the last 7 days.
files.save.help: Saving replaces the file at once; the old version is not kept.
files.edit.toobig: This file is larger than 2 MB, too large for the editor. Download it instead.
files.edit.binary: This is not a text file. Download it instead.
files.edit.wpconfig: wp-config.php holds the website's settings. A mistake here takes the website offline until it is fixed.
files.err.list: The folder could not be read:
files.err.name: Name is not valid (no / and not . or ..).
files.done.delete: Moved to the trash (restorable for 7 days).
db.title: Database
db.err: The database could not be read:
db.name: Database
db.user.help: (password stays in the website's secret file)
db.export.help: Downloads a fresh copy of the whole database as .sql.gz. The website keeps running.
db.import.help: Runs an .sql or .sql.gz file (up to 512 MB) against this database. A copy of the current database is taken first and kept, so the import can be undone.
db.import.confirm: I understand that tables in the file replace the ones in this database
db.import.type: Only .sql or .sql.gz files can be imported.
db.backups.help: The newest 3 are kept. Import one to undo an import.
db.sql.warn: Statements run at once on the live database and cannot be undone here. Download an export first if you are not sure.
db.sql.help: SELECT shows at most 1000 rows; long values are shortened.
db.sql.ok: Done. The statement returned no rows.
db.rows.help: Row counts of InnoDB tables are estimates.
db.done.import: Import finished. A copy from before the import is kept below.
wp.check.title: Integrity check result
wp.check.plugins.bad: Some plugins changed or could not be checked
wp.check.help: Compares files with the official checksums on wordpress.org. Premium or custom plugins have no checksums there and show as "could not be checked"; that is normal.
wp.cli.help: Runs one WP-CLI command in this site's own container (user www-data, no shell). Interactive commands (shell, db cli) and --ssh/--http/--path are not available. Time limit 3 minutes.
wp.err.name: Not a valid plugin or theme name.
wp.install.help: Enter the slug from the wordpress.org address, for example wordpress.org/plugins/wordfence → wordfence.
wp.item.name: Name
wp.login.title: Opening wp-admin
wp.login.help: This link works once and for 60 seconds. If it expired, press Log in to wp-admin again in the panel.
wp.sec.ssladmin: Login and wp-admin always over HTTPS
wp.sec.fileedit: File editor in wp-admin turned off
wp.sec.isolated: Site isolated in its own Docker stack (database not open to the internet)
wp.tls.until: valid until %s (%d days left), renewed automatically
wp.update.everything.ask: Update WordPress, every plugin and every theme now? Tip: export the database first in the Database tab.
wp.delete.plugin.ask: Delete plugin %s? It is deactivated, its data cleaned up and its files removed. This cannot be undone.
wp.delete.theme.ask: Delete theme %s? Its files are removed. This cannot be undone.
wp.set.debug.help: PHP errors go to the site Logs (never shown to visitors).
wp.set.indexing.help: Turn off while the site is still a draft so it stays out of Google.
wp.set.system_cron.help: Scheduled tasks run from the server every 5 minutes instead of on visits. Faster pages, tasks still on time.
wp.set.maintenance.help: Visitors see a "under maintenance" page (503); logged-in admins still see the site.
wp.err.read.plain: Usually the website is stopped or just starting. Start it from the Overview tab, wait a moment, then reload this page.
wp.warn.title: Some details could not be shown
wp.warn.part.plugins: The plugin list could not be read, so plugin updates may be missing.
wp.warn.part.themes: The theme list could not be read, so theme updates may be missing.
wp.warn.part.core: Checking for a newer WordPress failed (usually wordpress.org could not be reached).
wp.warn.part.other: Some other detail could not be read.
wp.warn.plain: The website keeps running and everything else still works. Reload this page later. If this keeps showing, send the technical details to your admin.
bak.title: Backup
bak.help: A backup is a complete copy of this website: every file and the whole database, in one archive. You can put the website back to any backup in this list.
bak.offsite: Backups are kept on this server, and every night at 03:30 WIB the server's off-site backup carries them to outside storage too.
bak.daily: Make a backup every day (after 02:00 WIB)
bak.schedule.help: Older daily backups are removed by themselves. Backups you make by hand are never removed automatically.
bak.none: No backup yet. Make the first one with the button above.
bak.err: The backup list could not be read right now. The website itself is not affected; try again in a minute.
bak.restore.warn: This puts the website back to how it was on %s. Changes made after that are replaced. A safety copy of the website as it is now is made first, so this can be undone.
bak.restore.mismatch: The typed domain does not match. Nothing was restored.
bak.delete.ask: Delete the backup of %s? This cannot be undone.
bak.job.wait: You can leave this page; the work goes on in the background.
bak.job.restored: The website is back. The state before the restore is kept as the safety copy %s.
bak.job.fail.backup: The backup could not be made. The website itself was not changed.
bak.job.fail.restore: The restore did not finish. If the website looks wrong, restore the newest safety copy in the list below.
bak.step.switch files: Website switched to the restored files
bak.step.now.safety database: Making a safety copy of the database…
bak.step.now.safety files: Making a safety copy of the files…
bak.step.now.switch files: Switching the website to the restored files…
bak.restore.title: Restore the backup of %s
sites.app.wordpress.help: Blog, company profile or shop, installed and ready to log in.
sites.app.php.help: Your own PHP code (plain PHP, CodeIgniter, Slim…), with a MariaDB database if you want one.
sites.app.static.help: HTML, or the built output of React, Vue, Svelte or Astro. No PHP, no database.
sites.title.optional: Optional: shown on the starter page.
sites.creates.php-apache: Containers: Apache with PHP. Own private network; only the web server is reachable through the edge.
sites.creates.php-nginx: Containers: Nginx and PHP-FPM. Own private network; only Nginx is reachable through the edge.
sites.creates.static: Container: Nginx serving your files read-only. Unknown paths fall back to index.html (for React/Vue routes).
sites.creates.db: Plus a MariaDB database on the private network.
sites.resources.php-apache: Up to 512 MB memory; disk grows with the website.
sites.resources.php-nginx: Up to 640 MB memory (128 MB Nginx, 512 MB PHP); disk grows with the website.
sites.resources.static: Up to 128 MB memory; disk grows with the website.
sites.resources.db: The database adds up to 512 MB.
sites.job.appnext: Your website is live with a starter page. Upload your site with the File Manager (a .zip can be extracted there), replacing the starter page.
sites.app.laravel.help: A fresh Laravel project with a MariaDB database, queue worker and scheduler, ready to use.
sites.creates.laravel: Containers: Nginx, PHP-FPM (Laravel image built from official images), queue worker, scheduler, MariaDB database. The latest Laravel is installed with Composer; the panel fills .env.
sites.resources.laravel: Memory up to 1.6 GB (Nginx 128 MB, PHP 512 MB, queue 256 MB, scheduler 256 MB, database 512 MB); disk grows with the website.
sites.step.now.build PHP image: Building the PHP image (1–3 minutes the first time)…
sites.job.laravelnext: Laravel is running. Change the code with the File Manager; after adding migrations, press Run migrate on the Overview.
lar.title: Laravel
lar.help: Artisan commands that are safe to run from the panel. Other commands cannot be run from here.
lar.env: App settings are in the .env file (File Manager). The database password is not in it: the panel hands it over from a secret file.
